findings.issue: Finding 1: Four brief hex values were darkened for AA contrast (muted #697586→#5f6875, success #16A34A→#166534, warning #F59E0B→#92400E, error #DC2626→#B91C1C). AC-002 requires the brief's exact hex, and T1.7 permitted only two value changes. The two requirements conflict: with the brief values the text pairs measure 4.44:1, 3.30:1, 2.15:1 and 4.83:1 (4.13:1 on tint), below NFR-003's 4.5:1. The owner reviewed the trade-off and accepted the accessible values for this release; AC-002's wording should be amended rather than the code reverted.

NFR-002/004/006/007/008/009 are not measured in a browser. /design-system sits behind ProtectedRoute, so measuring requires the API server plus a seeded dev account, which this review did not provision. NFR-003, NFR-001 and NFR-005 are measured and pass.

Two server test-infrastructure files changed in the same branch (hookTimeout raised to 90s, server test script gains --runInBand). Test-only, no production behaviour, but outside BP-006's planned surface.
